in_marathi.name: Rajni
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rajni हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rajni is a name of ancient Indian origin, derived from the Sanskrit language. It is a feminine form of Raj, meaning 'ruler' or 'king'. In Hindu mythology, Rajni is a title given to various goddesses, including Rajrani, the queen of Rajasthan, and Rajeshwari, the goddess of wealth and prosperity. This name is full of strength and power, symbolizing leadership and governance.
